cli.err.name: enter a client or company name
cli.title: Clients
cli.lock.h: Clients from your computer need encryption
cli.lock.p: These are other people's phone numbers and emails, so they travel between your devices only encrypted. Turn on “Encrypt on device” in sync settings here and on the computer — and your clients will appear here. Anything you add here will go there too.
cli.empty.p: Tell Lira: “note: John from Acme wants 200 boxes by Friday” — the card is created automatically. Or tap “New client”.
cli.next_ph: What to do: call back, send an invoice…
cli.err.when: couldn't understand when — e.g. “tomorrow at 11”, “on Friday”
cli.f.name: Name or company
cli.deals_empty_p: Tell Lira: “we invoiced Acme 1200 for boxes, due Friday” — the deal appears here and on the client's card.
cli.r.brief: Say it briefly, in your own words.
cli.r.no_owed: Nobody owes anything — no open invoices.
cli.r.noted: Saved to the card “{c}” (Clients). Say so in one sentence.
cli.r.err_when: Error: couldn't understand when — ask the user.
cli.r.err_what: Error: what should be done? Ask the user.
cli.r.no_deal: Error: no such deal for “{c}”{have}. Ask which one.
pci.on_p: You can hand big jobs to it right from here — by voice or text.
pci.off_p: Install Dewiar on your computer (Windows, Linux or Mac) and sign in to the same account — your phone and computer become one team.
pci.ask_h: Hand a job to the computer from here
pci.ask_p: Say: “ask the computer to put together a report on competitors” — research, a document, a presentation, work with files or code. Progress and the result appear in “My day” → “Done”.
pci.here_h: Here — just like on the computer
pci.i.clients_d: cards, history, who owes — by voice too
pci.i.tasks_d: big jobs with files, code and the web
pci.i.mailing_d: emails to clients, a Telegram channel
pci.i.sites_d: Lira builds a site or an episode
pci.i.hands_d: controls the computer and watches windows
hud.st.loading: Getting ready: loading hearing and voice
hud.st.sleep: Sleeping. Call me by name — or tap my face.
hud.st.finishing: One moment — finishing the previous one
hud.st.heavy: Working on something heavy — please wait a bit
hud.voice_off_t: Answering with text only — voice is muted.
hud.st.done_free: Answer finished: you can speak right away, no name needed

hud.bal.empty_site: AI balance on dewiar.pro is empty — top it up
